page.content:
The Benedictors is a Codex Astartes-compliant Loyalist Space Marine Chapter of unknown Founding and origin. Almost nothing is known about this Chapter in Imperial records.

Did you know?

  • Evidence around Benedictors is classified as fiction on Ton-o-Lore.

Sources & further reading

Fandom wiki
page.overview:
What is Benedictors?

The Benedictors is a Codex Astartes-compliant Loyalist Space Marine Chapter of unknown Founding and origin. Almost nothing is known about this Chapter in Imperial records.

The Benedictor's Chapter colours are not listed in current Imperial records.

The Benedictor's Chapter badge is not listed in current Imperial records.
